heading.name: Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Plaza, A Fairmont Hotel

section.heading: Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Plaza, A Fairmont HotelGet the celebrity treatment with world-class service at The Plaza, A Fairmont Hotel
section.paragraph:
Located at the crossroads of Central Park and 5th Avenue, this internationally renowned Manhattan hotel is steps away from world class shopping.
The luxurious and spacious rooms at The Plaza boast modern bathrooms with 24-karat gold-plated fixtures and separate rain showers.
The Plaza Hotel is home to The Palm Court Restaurant, one of New York City's finest destinations for Afternoon Tea.
Amenities at The Plaza include exclusive boutiques and health and wellness facilities including a Guerlain Spa and 24-Hour Fitness Center.Located at the crossroads of Central Park and 5th Avenue, this internationally renowned Manhattan hotel is steps away from world class shopping.
The luxurious and spacious rooms at The Plaza boast modern bathrooms with 24-karat gold-plated fixtures and separate rain showers.
The Plaza Hotel is home to The Palm Court Restaurant, one of New York City's finest destinations for Afternoon Tea.
Amenities at The Plaza include exclusive boutiques and health and wellness facilities including a Guerlain Spa and 24-Hour Fitness Center.
